name: Critical Spell (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Magus 9

Benefit: Whenever the magus scores a critical hit with a spell’s attack roll without delivering the spell through a weapon strike, he may immediately take a single melee weapon attack as a free action. The weapon strike may be made against any foe within the magus’s reach. The magus can use this ability once per day.
